verification_methodology.disclosure: Social violation uses an explicit authored geometric rule: the conversational corridor is the oriented capsule connecting the two facing speakers' torsos and gaze vectors. Both pairs use native Microsoft Rocketbox FBX walk/turn/talk/listen clips with planted soles. Intrusion triggers an authored stop/step-aside/rejoin response; occupancy, visibility, and delay are measured from 3D geometry and execution time (no fabricated contact Newtons).
